findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子載明：他公司的產品、製程或技術（含低成本替代品）可能使 BSX 產品過時或較缺競爭力；次世代產品上市延遲可能導致市占下滑。
findings.excerpt: Developments by other companies of products and/or services, processes or technologies, including low-cost alternatives, may make our products or proposed products obsolete or less competitive and may negatively impact our net sales.

clues.claim: MD+DI 報導：BSX 電生理部門在 PFA 領域受 Medtronic、J&J、Abbott 競爭，營收低於預期約 3,300 萬美元。
clues.source: MD+DI: Boston Scientific's Electrophysiology Segment Earnings Confirm Investor Fears

clues.claim: MD+DI 報導：Medtronic Sphere-9 取得進展並在歐洲推出 Sphere-360，BSX PFA 主導地位流失快於預期。
CHAMPION-AF 達全部主要與次要終點：Watchman FLX 對 NOAC 之出血較低（15.1% vs 21.8%），為 LAAC 取代長期抗凝血藥的臨床證據。
clues.source: Boston Scientific press release via Nasdaq/Barchart: CHAMPION-AF
